# Independent audit of the body-tied volume/energy buffer

Source: body-tied-volume-energy-buffer-attainment-and-exact-response-rate-geometry.md.


conditional on construction of the NEW H-specific cover and actual common
physical response cone. They do not import the old free-parameter separator.
No numerical mixed-integer Grunbaum payment is supplied by this audit.

## 1. Definition, compactness, and proper sources

Put N=d+1 and

    H=(E V^(1/d))^(1/N),       f_H=H/M^(1/d).

Since F=E^(1/d) and v=V^(1/d) are jointly concave, the positive weighted
geometric mean H=F^(d/N)v^(1/N) is concave. In a fixed positive fiber,
v is constant and strict concavity of F gives the asserted strict
concavity. The boundary value is zero. E<=V gives
f_H<=(V/M)^(1/d)<=1. A common continuous affine determinant J multiplies
H and M^(1/d) by the same factor |J|^(1/d).

The archived compact minimal-bad family supplies positive uniform fiber
volumes, common inner and outer radii, and positive covariance bounds.
The cap comparison uses a continuous-normal unit normalization and is
uniform in the base tilt. Thus it covers oblique halfspaces. The finite
pure-base traces are handled separately. The uniform slab estimate
justifies simultaneous infima and maxima under Hausdorff convergence.

At an ordinary deepest mark, the largest-fiber centroid lower bound and
the own-mark depth Lipschitz estimate give a uniform interior ball.
Buffered deepest marks retain such a ball by the O(epsilon) upper error.
Monotonicity of projective energy gives E>=omega_d r_s^d.

Every nonvertical buffered cap at the ordinary deepest mark gains an
own-ball strip of uniformly positive section area and width bounded below
by a positive constant times epsilon. For pure-base caps, perturbing the
base normal in the two opposite continuous directions splits the
boundary-fiber contribution, and one perturbed cap loses at least half
the own fiber. This proves the reserve V_p/2 and closes the infimum over
both cap types. Consequently the two-sided linear value gap and the
uniform properness reserve in Sections 3--4 are valid under the stated
compactness inputs. The logarithmic scale minimization then has the
stated positive attainment and epsilon comparable to tau.

## 2. Exact charts

The energy derivative is grad_y log E=N a_Y. Therefore

    grad_y log f_H=a_Y.

Let S>=F and T>=v be affine supports touching at the source and its
base. Then

    R_Y=(d/N)S/F_Y+(1/N)T/v_p

satisfies H(Y)R_Y>=H by weighted AM--GM, with equality at Y.
Its continuous gradient is exactly a_Y, so its own-fiber restriction
is the actual energy normalizer P_Y. Positivity of S and T>=v_min
gives R_Y>=v_min/(N v_p), without a parameter singularity.

One wording clarification is useful on a homothetic source face.
The single affine function H(q)R_q touches H at every face source.
At another source Y_i one has R_q(Y_i)=H(Y_i)/H(q), which need not be
one. Its own normalized chart is R_q/R_q(Y_i). This is consistent with
all the source's subsequent formulas.

## 3. Direct verification of the signed response

For inward speed v, write dot E=-C_E, dot V_p=-D_p and dot M=-D.
Logarithmic differentiation gives exactly

    dot f_H/f_H=-C_E/(N E)-D_p/(d N V_p)+D/(d M).

For Gamma(u)=1, differentiating the pooled covariance gives

    dot Gamma/Gamma=D/(2M)-J(u)/(2M).

The derivatives of individual fiber centroids vanish against their old
centered first moments. Adding the two identities yields

    -C_E/(N E)-D_p/(d N V_p)
       +(d+2)D/(2dM)-J(u)/(2M).

The contact-budget formula therefore has the displayed own-energy,
own-volume, covariance, total-mass and optional log-scale signs.
The continuous contact relation is U_i=delta_ia a_ia; no free-parameter
continuous gradient is present.

## 4. The conditional separator and its exact scope

For a cap, an inward body path contributes minus its selected boundary
loss, while the inward buffer change contributes the fractional response
above multiplied by its actual contact force. Normalizing by M adds
beta D. Moving all terms to the loss side gives precisely

    Xi=W-beta
       +sum_own e[P^(-N)/(N E)+1/(d N V)]
       +(1/(2M))sum_i e_i sum_j rho_ij[u_ij·(X-g_z)]^2
       -(d+2)Delta/(2dM).

In particular both the new own-volume term and the global coefficient
(d+2)/(2d) are necessary. They are not the old free-L coefficients.

Under the stated NEW actual realization cone, the inequality against
normal-dependent globally convex fields says that the positive boundary
measure A, whose density is W plus the three positive response terms,
is below B_star times ordinary boundary area in conditional convex
order, where B_star=beta+(d+2)Delta/(2dM).
Both signs of affine fields give equality of normal marginals and full
conditional physical first moments. The resulting martingale starts at
actual boundary points. It is not a martingale from the discrete
deepest sources, and no volume-row law follows from it.

The chart floors, source-core energy bounds and positive fiber-volume
bounds make all additional response densities O(epsilon), uniformly in
the fixed compact class. Thus this NEW response package has no inverse
parameter concentration branch. Supporting-facet capture allocations
remain part of W, and outside-surface payment remains unproved.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
